[← Back to Demos Gallery](index.qmd)

The live application below is running completely client-side in your browser using serverless **Shinylive** (WebAssembly). It provides a streamlined **Systems Ethology platform (`sysetholApp()`)** featuring tab-aware sidebar decluttering (`step_controls.R`), logarithmic step size slider (`Steps per click` when `nsim = 1`), display unit selection (**`Steps` vs `Time`**), sidebar **Run Engine** & **Reset** buttons, and modular output tabs (`sysetholOutput`: **Substrate Plots**, **Age Classes** population dynamics, **Envelope Plots** when `nsim > 1`, and **Input Data** via `inputApp`).

```{r, echo=FALSE, results='asis'}
source("shinylive_helpers.R")
render_standalone_app("sysetholApp", height = 880)
```

---

## Programmatic Application Usage

Launch the **Systems Ethology Platform** natively in R using exported package functions:

```r
library(ewing)

sysetholApp()
```
